torre-reloj.title: Clock Tower
torre-reloj.fact: Main gate of the walled city since the 17th century; the clock tower was added in 1888.

catedral.title: Cathedral of Saint Catherine of Alexandria
catedral.fact: Construction began in 1577. The tower you see today is an early 20th-century remodel.

san-pedro.title: Church of Saint Peter Claver
san-pedro.fact: 17th-century Jesuit church holding the remains of Saint Peter Claver, defender of enslaved people.

trinidad.title: Holy Trinity Church
trinidad.fact: The heart of Getsemaní: its square has been the neighborhood's meeting point since the 17th century.

castillo.title: San Felipe de Barajas Castle
castillo.fact: The largest fortress Spain built in the Americas, rising on San Lázaro hill from 1657.

moments.night: Night in the walled city: lit-up squares and music in Getsemaní.
moments.dawn: Dawn over the sea: the walls catch the light before the streets.
moments.morning: Cool morning: a good time to walk the Old Town before the heat.
moments.noon: High sun: look for the shade of balconies and courtyards.
moments.afternoon: Caribbean afternoon: the sea breeze starts to come in.
moments.golden: Golden hour: the light falls across the walls and façades.
moments.dusk: Dusk: the sky paints itself over the bay.
